desc: Read input N, X and the list of (U_i, D_i) pairs.
Calculate the sum of all (U_i + D_i) and the upper bound for H (min(U_i + D_i)).
Implement the `check(H)` function with forward and backward interval propagation.
Implement binary search to find the maximum feasible H.
Compute and print the result: total_sum - N * max_H.
Test with sample inputs to verify correctness.
